Explanation of Table 8-2
Line 1. "Installed Capacity" - generating capacity of the proposed project or alternative. The installed capacity of alternative nonhydro generating stations is adjusted to provide equivalent availability (as determined by differences in forced outage rate experience) comparable to the proposed project. In this study the installed capacities required to accomplish this were obtained from Applicant's computer program (Procos Program) studies and are based on equal loss-of-load probabilities for project and alternatives.
Lines 2 and 3. "Capital Cost" - estimated cost of generating plant, substation, and transmission line (when required). Interest during construction is included and costs are escalated to mid-point of construction period.

Lines 5(a), 5(b), and 5(c). "Fixed Annual O&M plus A and G" - O&M (operation and maintenance) costs are national average per kW of installed capacity for the type plant indicated. Included are such items as inspection and repair of generator and replacement of turbine blades; inspection and replacement of boiler tubes and condenser tubes; inspection and repair of auxiliaries; lubrication; etc. A and G (administrative and general costs) are national averages and are calculated as a percentage of fixed O&M, 39 percent for generating plant and 32 percent for substations and transmission lines.
